summary: Pass-through TOP that has no effect on the image and acts as an instance of the input TOP. Use it as a stable texture reference endpoint while adding or changing upstream TOPs.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Common TOP control for using input resolution, scaling it, fitting/limiting it, or choosing a custom resolution.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Custom output width and height when Output Resolution is set to Custom Resolution.

key_params.name: resmult
key_params.note: Applies the global TOP resolution multiplier from preferences.

key_params.name: outputaspect
key_params.note: Chooses input, resolution-derived, or custom output aspect ratio.

key_params.name: aspect
key_params.note: Custom aspect ratio pair used when Output Aspect is Custom Aspect.

key_params.name: inputfiltertype
key_params.note: Input image filtering: nearest, linear, or mipmap.

key_params.name: fillmode
key_params.note: Controls how the TOP image fills the node viewer.

key_params.name: filtertype
key_params.note: Viewer filtering: nearest, linear, or mipmap.

key_params.name: npasses
key_params.note: Repeats the TOP operation multiple times by feeding each pass back into the first input.

key_params.name: chanmask
key_params.note: Chooses which RGBA channels the TOP operates on.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Pixel format used to store image channel data.

common_gotchas: No Null-page parameters are documented; tune Common page resolution, aspect, filtering, channel mask, and pixel format only when you intentionally want the endpoint to normalize texture metadata.
Use Input for resolution and aspect when the Null TOP should preserve upstream texture dimensions exactly.
Use an Info CHOP to confirm resx, resy, depth, and gpu_memory_used when a stable TOP endpoint feeds rendering, instancing, or external output.
Keep downstream TOP references pointed at a named Null TOP so upstream network edits do not require reference updates.
